content:
A credible leaker with a track record has shared what appears to be a video showing the two new colors of the iPhone 18 Pro on display in a retail store.

The short clip shows the dark cherry and blue colors we'd expect, but is almost certainly faked…

The video, which is just 14 seconds long, shows someone holding a dark cherry iPhone 18 Pro Max alongside a dark blue iPhone 17 Pro Max for comparison. A light blue model is also seen sitting on a display stand.

The setting looks like a retail store. Macworld thinks it might be real.

But I'm more skeptical.

My colleague Fernando Silva was just at the IFA trade show and says every case company has dummy units that look and feel very realistic, so getting hold of these is hardly difficult. Also, the store environment feels suspicious to me. The display table is unreasonably small for a store, and the product labels appear not to be fixed in place and are just placed at an angle. We also don't see any credible store backdrop.

Finally, while this leaker has had a decent track record in the past, lately they've basically just been reposting posts from Chinese social media.
